reference_sql:
SELECT cp.product_id, cp.competitor, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur, ph.list_price_eur
FROM competitor_prices cp
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = cp.product_id AND CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) >= ph.valid_from AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) <= ph.valid_to)
WHERE c.category_name = 'TVs 50-55 inch' AND cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10'
alternatives: SELECT cp.product_id, cp.competitor, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur, ph.list_price_eur FROM competitor_prices cp JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = cp.product_id AND CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN ph.valid_from AND COALESCE(ph.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') WHERE c.category_name = 'TVs 50-55 inch' AND CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09'

WITH checks AS (SELECT cp.product_id, cp.competitor, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur, CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE) AS check_date FROM competitor_prices cp JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'TVs 50-55 inch' AND cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10') SELECT k.product_id, k.competitor, k.observed_ts, k.price_eur, ph.list_price_eur FROM checks k JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = k.product_id AND k.check_date >= ph.valid_from AND (ph.valid_to IS NULL OR k.check_date <= ph.valid_to)

other_way.tradeoff: BETWEEN with COALESCE is shorter, but the far-off end date stands in for a missing valid_to and must be chosen with care.

solver.query:
SELECT cp.product_id, cp.competitor, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur, h.list_price_eur
FROM competitor_prices cp
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = cp.product_id
  AND h.valid_from <= CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE)
  AND (h.valid_to IS NULL OR h.valid_to >= CAST(cp.observed_ts AS DATE))
WHERE c.category_name = 'TVs 50-55 inch'
  AND cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
